Offline password generator and keeper. No account, no sync, no internet.

**Downloads and install help:** <https://niyexdroid.github.io/vaultify/>

| Platform | File | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10 / 11 | `Vaultify-*-Setup.exe` | Supported |
| Android 10+ | `Vaultify-*.apk` | Supported, install directly |
| Android (Play) | `Vaultify-*.aab` | For a future Play Store listing |
| macOS | `Vaultify-*.dmg` | Preview: unsigned, not yet tested on a Mac |
| iOS | `Vaultify-*-ios-unsigned.zip` | Preview: unsigned, not installable as is |

Nothing is code-signed yet, so the first install warns: on Windows choose
**More info** then **Run anyway**; on Android allow installs from your browser
or file manager when prompted.

[Privacy policy](https://niyexdroid.github.io/vaultify/privacy.html) — Vaultify
collects nothing, and the Android release build is not even granted internet
permission, so it cannot send your data anywhere.
